result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but there are a few visual inconsistencies: the favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card uses a dark fill that makes the icon nearly invisible, the first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail has a light background that clashes with the other dark thumbnails, and the bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' while the home feed is displayed.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' is rendered as a dark circle with a dark outline heart, so the icon is barely visible against its background. The equivalent button on the ramen card above uses a white circle with a dark heart, so the two are visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same white/translucent circular background and dark heart stroke to all favorite buttons, and ensure the icon meets contrast requirements over any image.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar shows 'Profile' as the active (green, filled) tab while the screen displays the home feed. The active state does not match the current view.
issues.suggestion: Bind the active tab state to the current route so 'Home' is highlighted on the home feed.

issues.description: The first card thumbnail in 'Fastest near you' (Green Bowl Poké) has a pale grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails use dark backgrounds, making the row look inconsistent, and the bowl artwork appears off-centre/cropped at the left edge.
issues.suggestion: Normalise thumbnail background treatment (or add a consistent overlay) and centre/cover-crop the imagery so all cards in the carousel match.

issues.description: The 'See all' links and the notification bell with red dot have no visible text labels describing their target; the bell badge also conveys state by colour alone.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g. 'See all fastest restaurants', 'Notifications, 1 unread') for screen reader users.
